title: Well, I guess I've been having these dreams for decades and didn't realize it.
content: Yesterday I found an old journal in a box, which I started as a dream journal when I was taking Larium/Meflaquine, an anti-malarial drug that among the listed side effects are "intense dreams\*." It can also cause paranoia, which is why I switched to another malaria prophylaxis. But I kept the journal as a dream journal and haven't re-read it for nearly 20 years. One entry starts off: &#x200B; >Again with the K-Mart! I don't know why, but a lot of my dreams include the K-Mart from \[town I grew up in\]. What's up with that? Plus plenty of entries about strip malls, office buildings (I hadn't ever worked in an office job at the time), and plenty of locations that come up here as well. But.... \* Larium's side effects can hit people differently. The problem with the "intense dreams" is that it's almost universal that if you have them as a side effect, someone dies. Not just me, it's a known side effect. In dreams I remembered while on Larium, without fail, at least one person died every single time. Sometimes it was a main feature of the dream, sometimes a thing that happens quickly to the side, then keep on going with the dream. The absolute worst Larium dream I ever had was one where I was the one killed. I was running through a building and the ceiling panels were all just columns of cement that were trying to smash me. I ran for what seemed like an hour trying to find a safe place. Other people around me just staring, unwilling or unable to help, unaffected by the tiles that wouldn't smash them. Eventually, I was cornered and the tiles got me. In a jewelry store. *In.the.motherfucking.mall.*
